observed.head: 5af5a63bf7726afbfd8933d786efb62043cad3a7
observed.exception: IOException: The pipe is being closed

cause: The cmd stand-in exits after writing its marker without consuming the factory's required prompt stdin; the parent's send can race with exit.
fix: Drain stdin to EOF in the harmless probe before writing the marker file; include S2 with S51 in early Windows regression.
assertions: Existing low-privilege identity, job object, ACL, process marker, exit and file-content assertions retained.
